column1: # The declared packet world of the narrow evidence substrate (VAL-SUB-010).
# It is a BOUNDED, declared fixture world, not a corpus: one changed file in two
# revisions, two exact declared regions of its head revision (the two changed
# regions), the mandatory changed-entrypoint manifest for that diff, and the
# declared packets that reference them. The sealed source bytes live beside the
# DSH tool (`platform/dsh/tool/fixtures/packet/`); the stage derives its byte
# counts from them and refuses a fixture that disagrees with the real bytes.
# A cue the world does not support is `-`; it is never a fabricated placeholder.
